editorial.description_en: Leather that has been worn long enough to darken unevenly, taken at its middle value.
editorial.description_ja: 使いこんだ革のような、深い茶。

provenance.derivation: Editorial construction, not a measurement. Specified in OKLCh as L 0.486, C 0.078, h 56.0° and converted to canonical D65 XYZ by @irodora/color-spaces 0.1.0 (oklchToXyz), rounded to six decimal places. Re-derivable from this sentence alone.
provenance.editorialNotes: Name coined by Irodora: 古 (furu, old) + 革 (kawa, leather). It is not asserted to be a traditional Japanese colour name, and the hyphenated romaji marks it as a constructed compound (ADR-0065). "Old Leather" is an editorial decision about what communicates in English, not a literal translation of 古革. Relations asserted from measured proximity under the current engine, not from a source: related is the three nearest in CIELAB — chiri-ba at ΔE00 4.0, kare-eda at ΔE00 7.2, doro-kabe at ΔE00 7.9. complementary is the entry nearest the opposite OKLCh hue (236°), within 22°. historicalVariants is empty: this entry makes no historical claim to vary from.
